about_the_game:
【Game Information】

When the girl woke up, she had lost all her memories. 

　
She found herself aboard a train running through the stars. 

　

It seems to be a strange kind of train—one that only a few lives, those who have wished for death, ever receive a ticket to ride. 

　
Stranger still, they say the memories you’ve forgotten begin to appear, taking shape within the train itself. 

　

　

To reclaim what was lost, you must face each memory—gently, and in the right way. 

　
That is the key to getting them back. 

　

　

You are a girl who has lost her memories. 
But you are not alone. 

　
With the help of your twin brother—who boarded the train with you—
and a quiet companion who’s been riding it far longer than anyone else,
you’ll begin your journey to face what you’ve forgotten. 

　

And at the journey’s end…

lies the result of your choice.

　

　

"Thank you for riding with us. "

　

　

【System】

"Until the End" is a command-based adventure visual novel. 

All choices are made through simple command selection—no action gameplay involved. 

  • Engine：RPG Maker MZ

  • Gameplay：Story-focused, no action elements

  • Language：English, Japanese (Switchable in-game. )

    　

This game is currently in development.

Updates about the full version will be shared as they become available.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild themes related to death and suicide, as well as some depictions of violence. It does not include explicit sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm.

Please be aware of these themes if you are sensitive.
